description: This file defines static helper methods and constants related to grain type prefixes in Orleans. It includes prefixes for system types, system targets, grain services, clients, and legacy grains, along with methods to identify if a grain type or id belongs to these categories.

classes.name: GrainTypePrefix
classes.description: A static class providing constants and extension methods for identifying grain type categories based on string prefixes.

methods.name: IsClient
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainType is a client type, based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsSystemTarget
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainType is a system target type, based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsLegacyGrain
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainType is a legacy grain, based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsGrainService
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainType is a grain service, based on its prefix.

methods.name: IsClient
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainId's type is a client, based on the GrainType prefix.

methods.name: IsSystemTarget
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the given GrainId's type is a system target, based on the GrainType prefix.
